claim: Splits whether it is raining from how the rain is actually drawn — the same downpour can be an invisible tag, photographic streaks, or hand-drawn white diagonals. This is where the anime look in a wet scene is won or lost.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: rain streaks, motion blurred rain, streaking raindrops
water droplets on lens, wet camera lens, raindrops on glass
water splash, splashing, impact ripples, spray
drawn rain lines, diagonal white lines, stylized rain
sheets of rain, curtain of rain, wall of water
